product_overview: EduReach is a public college marketing website with a single-page experience for exploring programs, faculty, campus life, placements, and contact details. It also includes a floating AI chatbot that answers questions about the college using a backend RAG service.
core_goals: Explore EduReach College’s programs and specializations
Review college highlights, achievements, and placement outcomes
Learn about mentors, campus life, events, and recruiter activity
Access contact information and quick navigation links
Ask the AI chatbot questions about courses, admissions, fees, and campus

features.name: College Home Page
features.description: A public landing page that introduces EduReach College with branding, hero content, and a call to explore programs.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Load the home page and see EduReach College branding and welcome content -> Explore the page overview -> Select the program exploration call to action -> Jump to the courses section

features.name: Single-Page Section Navigation
features.description: A sticky navigation experience that lets users move through the main sections of the site from one page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the page and see the top navigation -> Select About, Courses, Mentors, Campus, or Placements -> Scroll to the chosen section -> Continue browsing the next section as needed
Navigate to / -> Open the page on a narrow viewport -> Expand the navigation menu -> Review the available section links -> Collapse the menu after choosing or dismissing a section link

features.name: About and Achievements
features.description: Static informational content that describes the college and presents key achievement metrics.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the About section -> Read the college description and highlights -> Review the placement rate and package statistics

features.name: Courses Catalog
features.description: A program listing that presents the college’s academic offerings, seat counts, and average package information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Courses section -> Review the listed programs -> Confirm the available specializations such as Computer Science and AI & Data Science -> Compare seat counts and average package figures

features.name: Mentors, Campus Life, and Events
features.description: Faculty profiles and campus experience content that showcases mentors, student life, quotes, and event imagery.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Mentors section -> Review faculty profiles and mentor information -> Continue to the Campus and Events sections -> View campus life content, quotes, and event gallery items

features.name: Placements and Footer Information
features.description: Placement-focused content and footer links that surface recruiter activity, hiring stats, and contact details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Placements section -> Review recruiter logos and placement statistics -> Use the footer quick links to jump to About, Programs, Faculty, Campus Life, or Placements -> Read the contact email, phone number, and address

features.name: AI College Chatbot
features.description: A floating chat experience that lets users ask questions about the college and receive AI-generated responses.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the floating chat drawer -> Review the welcome message and suggested questions -> Select a suggested question such as asking about available courses -> See the chatbot response
Navigate to / -> Open the floating chat drawer -> Type a custom question about admissions, fees, or campus life -> Submit the message with keyboard or send action -> See the bot reply
Navigate to / -> Open the floating chat drawer -> Enter a question and submit it -> See an error message when the message cannot be processed -> Close the chat drawer

routes.description: Single-page college marketing site with section anchors and a floating AI chatbot
Unknown paths redirect to the home page

user_interactions: Click EduReach logo to stay on home
Click About, Courses, Mentors, Campus, and Placements links to scroll to sections
Click Login and Sign Up buttons (no navigation or auth occurs)
On a narrow viewport, open and close the hamburger menu

features.name: About and Achievements

user_interactions: Scroll to About and read college description and highlights
View placement rate and package stats

features.name: Courses Catalog

user_interactions: Scroll to Courses and review listed programs
Confirm Computer Science, AI & Data Science, and other specializations are visible

features.name: Mentors Campus Life and Events
features.description: Faculty cards, campus features, quotes, and events gallery
user_interactions: Scroll to Mentors and view faculty profiles
Scroll to Campus and Events sections

features.name: Placements and Footer

Use footer quick links to jump to About, Programs, Faculty, Campus Life, Placements

features.name: AI College Chatbot
features.description: Floating chat button opens a drawer to ask about courses, fees, admissions, and campus; messages go to the backend RAG API
user_interactions: Click the floating chat button to open EduReach Bot
See the welcome message and quick questions
Click a quick question such as What courses do you offer?
Type a custom question and send with the send button or Enter
See a bot reply or an error message if the API fails
Close the drawer with the X or minimize button

known_limitations.issue: Navbar Login and Sign Up buttons are UI-only and do not open auth pages or call APIs
known_limitations.impact: Auth-related tests will not find a real login flow

known_limitations.issue: App.jsx renders a leftover debug heading hello on every page
known_limitations.impact: Extra visible text on the public site

known_limitations.issue: Backend CORS origin defaults to http://localhost:5173 while the production preview serves on port 4173
known_limitations.impact: Chat API calls from the preview app may be blocked by CORS unless CLIENT_URL matches the preview origin

known_limitations.issue: Unknown routes only redirect to home; there are no dedicated About/Courses pages
known_limitations.impact: Section navigation uses hash anchors on a single page
